_comment: KIF NeuralFusion refiner config. enabled=false makes the sidecar serve the coherent compositor sprite instead of the neural output -- set enabled=true ONLY after a PROPER (multi-epoch) retrain, the current weights were undertrained (<1 epoch) and mangled sprites. img2img_strength low (~0.3) = keep compositor structure, only lightly refine; raise toward 0.5 for more model influence once the LoRA is well-trained. style_prompt MUST match prepare_dataset._STYLE (the LoRA trigger).
style_prompt: infinite fusion pokemon battle sprite, 2d pixel art, clean 1-pixel black outline, flat cel shading, limited palette, crisp hard edges, no anti-aliasing, no dithering, single creature centered on a plain white background, front three-quarter view
negative_prompt: blurry, jpeg artifacts, photo, realistic, 3d render, soft shading, gradient, watermark, text, signature, multiple creatures, extra limbs, deformed, smooth anti-aliasing
